import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_left p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x xl xr) pr) gr =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x xl (BinarySearchTree.Node p xr (BinarySearchTree.Node g pr gr))
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_left (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma view_node (v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    view (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) = view l ∪ view r ∪ {v} := rfl

lemma is_bst_node (v : Int) (l r : BinarySearchTree) :
    is_bst (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) ↔
      ((∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧ is_bst l ∧ (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧ is_bst r) :=
  Iff.rfl

lemma mem_view_node {y v : Int} {l r : BinarySearchTree} :
    y ∈ view (BinarySearchTree.Node v l r) ↔ (y ∈ view l ∨ y ∈ view r ∨ y = v) := by
  rw [view_node]
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

lemma zigzig_node (g p x : Int) (xl xr pr gr : BinarySearchTree)
    (h : zigzig_precond
      (BinarySearchTree.Node g (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x xl xr) pr) gr)) :
    zigzig (BinarySearchTree.Node g
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p (BinarySearchTree.Node x xl xr) pr) gr) h
      = BinarySearchTree.Node x xl
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p xr (BinarySearchTree.Node g pr gr)) := rfl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) :
    zigzig_postcond t (zigzig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact False.elim h_precond.2.1
  | Node g l gr =>
    cases l with
    | Empty => exact False.elim h_precond.2.2.1
    | Node p pl pr =>
      cases pl with
      | Empty => exact False.elim h_precond.2.2.2
      | Node x xl xr =>
        have hbst := h_precond.1
        rw [is_bst_node] at hbst
        obtain ⟨hg1, hpbst, hg2, hgr⟩ := hbst
        rw [is_bst_node] at hpbst
        obtain ⟨hp1, hxbst, hp2, hpr⟩ := hpbst
        rw [is_bst_node] at hxbst
        obtain ⟨hx1, hxl, hx2, hxr⟩ := hxbst
        have hxp : x < p := hp1 x (mem_view_node.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
        have hpg : p < g := hg1 p (mem_view_node.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
        rw [zigzig_node]
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, rfl⟩
        · rw [is_bst_node]
          refine ⟨hx1, hxl, ?_, ?_⟩
          · intro y hy
            rw [mem_view_node] at hy
            rcases hy with hy | hy | hy
            · exact hx2 y hy
            · rw [mem_view_node] at hy
              rcases hy with hy | hy | hy
              · exact lt_trans hxp (hp2 y hy)
              · exact lt_trans hxp (lt_trans hpg (hg2 y hy))
              · subst hy; exact lt_trans hxp hpg
            · subst hy; exact hxp
          · rw [is_bst_node]
            refine ⟨?_, hxr, ?_, ?_⟩
            · intro y hy
              exact hp1 y (mem_view_node.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl hy)))
            · intro y hy
              rw [mem_view_node] at hy
              rcases hy with hy | hy | hy
              · exact hp2 y hy
              · exact lt_trans hpg (hg2 y hy)
              · subst hy; exact hpg
            · rw [is_bst_node]
              refine ⟨?_, hpr, hg2, hgr⟩
              intro y hy
              exact hg1 y (mem_view_node.mpr (Or.inr (Or.inl hy)))
        · ext y
          simp only [mem_view_node]
          tauto
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with

  | _ => False

  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧
